sources.label: Kempen ZARP agreed-upon procedures report - August 12, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Kempen Audit's ISRS 4400 (Revised) agreed-upon procedures report dated August 12, 2026 covers ZARP balances on August 1, 2026. Procedure 2 verifies R88,628,434 in the Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company JHB account and R2,729,857 in ZARP's Standard Bank accounts, while procedure 3 verifies the on-chain contract balances across Ethereum, Solana, Base, and Polygon. The attached management reserve report states 81,540,357.77 ZARP in circulation and R91,047,231.03 of cash and equivalents; the verified account components total R91,358,291, and the verified gross contract balances total 82,755,910 before the stated treasury/frozen exclusions. The verified reserve balances therefore exceed the stated circulating liability. Kempen expressly states that an agreed-upon procedures engagement is not an assurance engagement and gives no opinion; the report also does not reconcile the R311,059.97 difference between the verified account components and the attached management total. The complete curated composition remains 100% ZAR fiat reserves.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kempen Audit ISRS 4400 (Revised) agreed-upon procedures report on ZARP's August 1, 2026 reserve and supply balances
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report verifies rand balances in the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and Standard Bank accounts, but does not provide a current reserve-asset subcategory or establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness and rehypothecation terms; it also leaves the management-total variance unreconciled.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Kempen verified the Old Mutual Wealth trust account and ZARP Standard Bank accounts, while management states that reserve funds are free of other debts, liens, and encumbrances and reserved exclusively for redemption. The materials do not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or a redemption settlement time.
